title: A pricing refactor that quietly breaks its callers
tagline: Python · signature change, boundary flip, async blocking, coverage gaps
description: A developer adds loyalty discounts and switches price formatting from currency codes to locales. The diff looks routine — but one caller still passes the old keyword, a threshold moved by one, a new lookup table was never defined, and a blocking sleep slipped into an async handler.
highlights: format_price dropped `currency` and gained a required `locale`; ChangeGuard checks every resolved call site against the new signature.
`percent > 50` became `percent >= 50` — a boundary change worth a boundary-value test.
REGIONAL_RATES is used but never defined, and a bare `except` swallows the NameError: every non-EU invoice silently skips regional tax.
The uploaded coverage report shows which changed lines no test ever executes.
